thread:
Lina (DevEx): Support flagged quota spikes to the global bucket starting 03:22 UTC after Go SDK 0.9.0 rollout. Quotas dashboard shows big untagged batches.
Omar (Go SDK): We shipped multiplexed batching; likely collapsed per-item route metadata into the stream envelope. didn't realize ingest relies on per-request headers.
Priya (Eng-Platform): Ingest logs confirm batches with only batch-level metadata. attribution falls back to tenant/global. that's why quotas shifted.
Jason (Console): Result: per-route charts underreport and an "ungrouped" line spikes. a few orgs hit quota alerts.
Tessa (Product): Immediate user impact? throttled or just noisy dashboards?
Lina (DevEx): Both. three customers briefly throttled by fallback global buckets; one escalated to SEs.
Omar (Go SDK): Proposals: 1) add compact route-table header (small footprint) 2) include per-item route idx in envelope 3) opt-out revert. I can prototype a compact header today.
Priya (Eng-Platform): Platform can expand a `Rdr-Batch-Routes` header into per-request tags at ingest. we'll gate via a flag and canary to 5% nodes. we'll also emit metric `batch_route_mapping_missing`.
Jason (Console): I'll add a temporary dashboard note and quick-filter for "affected by batching". want to avoid fragmenting historical charts; we should canonicalize expanded keys to `tenant:route:model`.
Tessa (Product): Recommend short-term: accept compact header and ask Go SDK to ship 0.9.1. prepare support playbook and reach out to impacted customers.
Deploy-Bot: infra: ingest-expand-batchroutes queued -> staging at 09:48 UTC.
Omar (Go SDK): Draft header plan: `Rdr-Batch-Routes: r1|r2|r3` and per-item `Rdr-Batch-Idx: 0,1,2,0`. small and parseable. pushing branch.
Priya (Eng-Platform): Canary plan: staging -> prod 5% for 1 hour, monitor `per_route_quota_hits` and `global_fallback_quota_rate`.
Lina (DevEx): Support playbook: 1) check logs for `batch_route_mapping_missing`, 2) ask customers to upgrade or set `RDR_CLIENT_BATCHING=false`, 3) escalate if persists. I'll draft and post.
Deploy-Bot: staging deploy succeeded at 10:12 UTC, prod canary started at 10:30 UTC. monitoring ok.
Lina (DevEx): Thanks team. Omar, please open a cross-SDK doc so python/ts adopt the same compact mapping. Close once 24h metrics look normal.
